name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: A healthy, well-fed Deshi cow raised on natural fodder. Calm temperament, ideal for Qurbani and easy to transport.

name: Australian Friesian Bull
description: Premium cross-bred bull, grain-fattened for six months. Strong build and heavy weight, a favourite for shared Qurbani.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: Purebred Black Bengal goat known for tender meat. Vaccinated and raised free-range on a family farm.

name: Totapari Cow
description: Distinctive parrot-faced Totapari cow, a well-known regional breed prized for its lean, flavourful meat.

name: Jamunapari Goat
description: Tall, long-eared Jamunapari goat with excellent meat yield. Hand-fed on a mixed diet of grass and grain.

name: Sahiwal Cow
description: Robust Sahiwal cow with a reddish-brown coat, raised on an open pasture. Well suited for a large family Qurbani.
